### Found by

reading `src/features/fees/FeeScreen.tsx` beside `src-tauri/src/fees/api.rs`

### Where

`src/features/fees/FeeScreen.tsx`, the `<select>`; `src/features/fees/gateway.ts`, `Zone`

### Observation

The three zones are written once in the backend and again as `<option>` elements. A fourth zone added to one is missing from the other with no failing test.

Blocked by #12: the zones get their one named place there first.

Done when: the screen builds its options from one list, which a test compares with the backend's zones.

S

Nothing.
title: The screen lists the zones by hand, apart from the backend's
